[SWS_DM_01384] SOVD mode communication_control set value
⌈
The SOVD method Explicit Control of Entity States via Their De-
fined Modes of SOVD mode communication_control with valid value in the
request body shall be processed analog to Service CommunicationControl (0x28) of
ISO 14229-1[1] using the same instance of the processing mechanism.
⌋
